task_name: Remove the retired server dependency surface

rubric.result: All three retired collaborators, their fields, constructor arguments, assignments and unused aliases/imports are removed. Named factories follow suit; the recovery mother now constructs RecordedPlanRecovery from record/call inputs.
The task explicitly declares No TDD for constructor cleanup.

ApiCollaborators no longer accepts implementPlan, implementationStarts or pullRequestReviews. PlanWatch remains required by EntrypointPlanSessionRegistry. GET/POST implementation-start 404 bodies and active-plan response contracts are retained.

ReviewWatch remains wired by ct-api into RecordedPlanRecovery. Surviving progress/history, live-session, coordinator and gate routes retain their collaborators and protocol/origin handling. No go protocol retirement, replay mechanism or new authority is introduced.

Constructor injection, TypeScript and named recovery scenarios match the applicable conventions. Closed vocabulary: no new classification or catch-all. Raw map as the return value of logic: none introduced; doubles return PlansInFlight and RecordedCall values. Two fields that have to agree: none introduced; unused constructor placeholders do not encode absence. Errors named for where they happen: no new error types. Existing-module exemptions apply under the package precedence.

The only removed assertion is the obsolete implementPlan spy check, expressly authorized by the brief. Both literal 404 assertions remain; the existing runtime test checks go-directory absence. Recovery diagnostic substitutions preserve exact status/body assertions. Other touched suites lose constructor arguments only.

Production ApiServer removes the dependency surface and retains the actual unrouted endpoint. The recovery fixture supplies real PlansInFlight.refused data to real RecordedPlanRecovery; its early refusal reaches the HTTP response before calls, checkout registration or reviews. Separate fixture/server ActivePlans instances therefore do not mask this refusal case. ClaudeCalls and HeadlessFiles constructors perform no IO; the injected spawn and filesystem are not reached. No successful recovery or disk persistence is claimed by this fixture.

Every hunk serves the specified constructor cleanup, authorized spy removal or recovery-mother conversion. Supplied controls1 green is treated as path-only evidence; this verdict is based on reading, without executing verification.
No new test is added; existing tests receive construction and diagnostic updates.
